record.summary: Passive.HUNGER_SWITCH has no PassiveEffects entry and no code reads the identifier itself. The behaviour described by its text is produced by two other mechanisms keyed on the unit NAME: (1) the AURA_WHEEL cast (aura-wheel.ts:15-24) toggles pokemon.name/index between MORPEKO and MORPEKO_HANGRY on every cast (the other form is chosen for any name that is not MORPEKO); (2) electricTripleAttackEffect (synergies.ts), installed only on units with the ELECTRIC synergy when the team has RISING_VOLTAGE, POWER_SURGE or SUPERCHARGED, applies on a triple attack (every 4th attack with RISING_VOLTAGE, every 3rd with POWER_SURGE / SUPERCHARGED, by pokemon.count.attackCount) triggerParalysis(2000) to the target when the name is MORPEKO and triggerWound(4000) when the name is MORPEKO_HANGRY, before the two extra attacks. Both Morpeko forms have the ELECTRIC/DARK types in their class block, so they receive the effect when the Electric synergy is active in the team; without it, no paralysis or wound is applied. Requested durations: paralysis 2000 ms (Storm x1.3, Electric Quartz, status-duration reductions; blocked by Rune Protect and IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS), wound 4000 ms (Blood Moon x1.3, reductions; blocked by Rune Protect). The wound effect on the target stops its ordinary healing (section J2), so the Hangry form's wound matters through handleHeal's wound branch. Nothing here is a heal, PP gain or shield on the unit itself.
